mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as badSupplierName, c2.C_Name as badProducerName, met.Met_Name as metName, mn.* from Me_Brand_Approval_Dtl mn left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Bad_Supplier left join Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Bad_Producer left join Me_Type_Library met on met.Met_Id=mn.Met_Id where mn.Ba_Id = #{baId} order by mn.Bad_Sort ASC

select pro.P_Name as pName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, con.Con_name as conName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Me_Brand_Approval mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileId = mn.Ba_Id where mn.Ba_Id = #{id}

select pro.P_Name as pName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, con.Con_name as conName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Me_Brand_Approval mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileId = mn.Ba_Id where mn.Ba_Id = #{id}
select count(*) from Me_Brand_Approval where P_Id = #{pId} and Con_Id = #{conId} and State = 7
